history.error.storage: Could not read or save history. Keep the files and try again.
history.error.busy: A turn or operation is running in this task or its folder — if you just updated, it may be the previous version's, which finishes its own work and retires. Wait for it to finish.
history.error.archived: This task is archived and no longer takes messages.
history.error.pinned: This task or one of its children is pinned. Unpin it before finishing or archiving.
history.error.missing_work: This task’s work folder is missing; it can’t continue there.
history.error.folder_gone: This task’s folder is no longer on disk. Committed work is still on its local branch: to continue, start a new task with that branch as its base.
history.error.git: Git could not complete backup or restoration. Keep the copy and review the details.
history.error.unprotected: Not all work can be protected: there are uncommitted or ignored files, files skipped by Git, submodules, LFS, filters, or incomplete history. Resolve this before backing up.
history.error.changed: The worktree or HEAD no longer matches the record. Work was not modified; review its state.
history.error.no_worktree: This task has no registered worktree of its own.
history.error.private_path: The backup would be inside the repository. Change the workspace location before backing up.
history.error.no_backup: No intact backup is available. Keep the existing files; no recovery was fabricated.
history.error.destination: The destination is not the missing owned folder or already exists. Nothing is overwritten: review the previous attempt.
history.error.incomplete: Restoration is incomplete. Keep the backup and review the destination before continuing; no turn will start in that folder.
history.resume_description: The previous worktree is no longer available. A new one will be created from the project’s base branch to continue this conversation.
history.error.no_repository: The project repository could not be found. Check its folder before writing again.
history.error.not_finished: The task has unintegrated work or its publication could not be verified. Save or merge the changes and try again.
history.error.unsaved_files: The folder has changes that aren't saved in Git: modified or new files. Save and merge them before finishing.
history.error.archive_unsaved: This task's folder has changes that aren't saved in Git, in modified or new files, and archiving retires the folder. Commit or discard them and archive again; anything already committed stays on its branch.
history.error.shared: This task shares work with other tasks and can’t be finished. You can archive it; its folder and branch will be kept.
history.error.consent_changed: Something changed in this task since you reviewed it: a new or modified file, or a turn that started. Nothing was touched; review the warning again.
